thread:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Juniper Labs just confirmed renewal but CFO insists on changing the billing entity to 'Juniper Holdings' (post-acq). Procurement now requires a vendor classification form + new W-9 before PO. They also want a 3-month dedicated capacity trial for performance validation before signing. Can we scope pricing and a safe signature path? :thinking:

alex_am: Thanks Maria. Do we have a standard pilot offer for Dedicated? We can do a timeboxed pilot but need to lock resources. My initial thought: 3-month pilot, 25% committed discount, and a training credit ($10k) as a concession. RevOps would want a PO or CC auth to reserve capacity.

jordan_revops: We can accept a PO from the new billing entity but we need the legal name exactly as on the W-9 for invoicing. Also need to update the SOW entity block. For accounting: will treat pilot as a credited prepayment against the annual commit if they convert. How many seats/throughput?

maria_cs: They're asking for 40 seats with burst to 80 during spike tests. Target model family: LlamaX 70B quantized; they'll run perf tests on an H100 pool. Annualized value if they commit is ~300k.

tim_legal: Quick legal notes — changing billing entity requires amendment to the Master Subscription Agreement with signatory confirmation. We can do a simple amendment: new billing entity + effective date + billing contact. If PO provided we accept it conditioned on the amendment. Also need to confirm whether KMS access is requested for the trial — KMS adds compliance steps.

alex_am: KMS not needed for pilot per their PM, but Juniper asked about key management if they go private later. For now, pilot can be hosted.

jordan_revops: Operational asks: if we allocate Dedicated GPUs for 3 months we should tag them as 'juniper-pilot' and set autoscale cap to avoid overruns. Please confirm throughput SLO and spike window so infra can quota.

maria_cs: I'll ask Juniper for spike schedule. Also they requested a slightly modified SOW clause for 'performance acceptance testing' — they want 72-hour SLA for support during tests. Can we commit?

tim_legal: 72-hour support window for testing is okay as a short-term addendum; Ops must confirm they can meet it. We can add a short-term appendix rather than change core SLA.

jordan_revops: Ops can support 72-hour response for the test window if it's scheduled and staffed. We'll need the PO to schedule.

maria_cs: Great. I'm going to collect the W-9 and PO from Juniper, and ask for a proposed test schedule. Can someone draft the amendment + SOW appendix and the pilot pricing?

alex_am: I'll draft the pricing addendum and SOW appendix — will include pilot discount, training credit, seat counts, and acceptance criteria. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

tim_legal: I'll start the amendment template and share redlines here.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: Juniper Labs — Pilot Amendment v1. Sender: alex_am. Link: https://docusign.example/ABC123 :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Perfect — once PO + W-9 arrive I'll upload to the thread and push for signature. Thanks team. :pray:
